concepts.name: Sinai Peninsula
concepts.definition: Triangular peninsula in Egypt forming a land bridge between Africa and Asia, lying between the Mediterranean Sea to the north and the Red Sea to the south.

concepts.name: Italian Peninsula
concepts.definition: Boot-shaped peninsula in south-central Europe, spined by the Apennines and extending from the Alps into the Mediterranean between the Tyrrhenian and Adriatic Seas.

concepts.name: Jutland
concepts.definition: Peninsula in Northern Europe forming mainland Denmark and part of northern Germany, separating the North Sea to the west from the Baltic Sea to the southeast.

concepts.name: Kola Peninsula
concepts.definition: Peninsula in the extreme northwest of Russia, largely within the Arctic Circle, bounded by the Barents Sea to the north and the White Sea to the southeast.

concepts.name: Baja California
concepts.definition: Long peninsula in northwestern Mexico, separated from the mainland by the Gulf of California and bordered on the west by the Pacific Ocean.

concepts.name: Yucatan Peninsula
concepts.definition: Large limestone peninsula of southeastern Mexico, Belize and Guatemala, separating the Gulf of Mexico to the north from the Caribbean Sea to the east.

concepts.name: Labrador Peninsula
concepts.definition: Large peninsula in eastern Canada spanning Quebec and Newfoundland and Labrador, bounded by Hudson Bay, Hudson Strait, the Labrador Sea and the Gulf of St. Lawrence.

concepts.name: Delmarva Peninsula
concepts.definition: Peninsula on the US East Coast shared by Delaware, Maryland and Virginia, lying between Chesapeake Bay to the west and Delaware Bay and the Atlantic Ocean to the east.

concepts.name: Guajira Peninsula
concepts.definition: Arid peninsula spanning northern Colombia and northwestern Venezuela, the northernmost peninsula of South America, ending at Punta Gallinas on the Caribbean.

concepts.name: Iberian Peninsula
concepts.definition: Peninsula in southwestern Europe comprising Spain, Portugal, Andorra and Gibraltar, separated from the rest of the continent by the Pyrenees.

concepts.name: Kamchatka Peninsula
concepts.definition: A 1,250-km-long volcanic peninsula in the Russian Far East, bounded by the Sea of Okhotsk to the west and the Bering Sea and Pacific Ocean to the east.

concepts.name: Malay Peninsula
concepts.definition: North-south peninsula in mainland Southeast Asia spanning parts of Thailand, Malaysia and Myanmar, holding the southernmost point of continental Asia and separated from Sumatra by the Strait of Malacca.

concepts.name: Scandinavian Peninsula
concepts.definition: Europe's largest peninsula, comprising mainland Norway, Sweden and northwestern Finland, extending about 1,850 km through Northern Europe with a quarter lying above the Arctic Circle.

concepts.name: Cape York Peninsula
concepts.definition: Large tropical peninsula forming the northernmost tip of mainland Australia, in Far North Queensland, between the Gulf of Carpentaria and the Coral Sea.

concepts.name: Peloponnese
concepts.definition: Mountainous peninsula forming the southernmost part of mainland Greece, linked to central Greece by the Isthmus of Corinth and home to ancient Sparta, Corinth and Mycenae.
